slot_scores.name: purchase_at_month_start
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked when purchases occur within the month, and its READY_TO_MODEL summary silently uses an end-of-month inventory balance without confirming purchase timing.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Purchases occur at the beginning of each month, or at least that purchase timing can be modeled with an end-of-month inventory balance without affecting capacity.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about intra-month purchase timing; it only used an end-of-month inventory balance and did not confirm whether purchases happen at the start or end of the month.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 hidden slot about purchase timing within the month remained unresolved.

summary: The agent asked several useful clarifying questions about inventory bounds, sales/purchase limits, and terminal inventory, but it missed the hidden P1 issue of when purchases occur within the month and then silently assumed an end-of-month inventory balance in its final model.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
